posts.snippet: We are looking for a Power BI Specialist in Bangalore !! Not just someone who can build dashboards. We need someone who can own the complete BI lifecycle, from SQL and data modelling through DAX ...
posts.author: Glen D'Souza
posts.content:
We are looking for a Power BI Specialist in Bangalore !!
Not just someone who can build dashboards.
We need someone who can own the complete BI lifecycle, from SQL and data modelling through DAX, visualization, refresh automation, troubleshooting and business adoption.
Core skills we are looking for:
-Power BI Desktop & Service
-Advanced DAX & Power Query
-Strong SQL & Data modelling
-ERP/CRM data integration
-Gateways & scheduled refresh
-Row-Level Security
-Dashboard performance optimization
-Data validation & troubleshooting
-Strong business understanding
-Integrating AI-driven insights
-Developing natural-language Q&A and conversational analytics experiences
-Exploring AI-assisted forecasting
🎓 PL-300 certification and exposure to Microsoft Fabric .

Apply or share this post with someone who would be a great fit. share your CV with  parthiban.moorthy@centena.com.
#PowerBI #Hiring #DubaiJobs #DataAnalytics #BusinessIntelligence #SQL #MicrosoftFabric parthiban.moorthy@centena.com.

We Are Hiring – Business Analyst (BA) / Business Development Executive (BDE) | Dubai, UAE
🚀 Excellent Webworld is looking for skilled professionals to join its Dubai team!
📍 Location: Dubai, UAE
💼 Experience: 2+ Years
**Open Positions:**
🔹 Business Analyst (BA)
🔹 Business Development Executive (BDE)
**Key Requirements:**
- Relevant BA or BDE experience
- Strong communication skills
- Business analysis and documentation (BA)
- Client relationships and business development (BDE)
- Strong coordination and problem-solving abilities
⭐ Immediate joiners preferred.
⭐ Candidates currently based in Dubai will receive preference.
📩 **How to Apply:**
Send your updated resume to: https://lnkd.in/dWWPYUfs
🚫 Do NOT send CVs via LinkedIn DM
✅ Click on the job link
✅ Click Apply Now on the website
📧 You will see the official HR email
📩 Send your CV directly to the email above.
